description: "Forest Pictures in the Adirondacks" by Alfred Billings Street is a collection of poetry written in the mid-19th century. This lyrical work captures the essence of the natural beauty and sublime landscapes found in the Adirondack region, focusing on the interplay of nature's elements and the emotional responses they evoke in the observer.
